args.sql:
SELECT 
    p.productid AS "产品ID",
    p.name AS "产品名称",
    pi.locationid AS "库位ID",
    pi.quantity AS "数量",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pi.locationid ORDER BY pi.quantity DESC) AS "排名"
FROM production.productinventory pi
JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = pi.productid
WHERE pi.locationid BETWEEN 3 AND 4
ORDER BY pi.locationid, pi.quantity DESC;

arguments.question: 查询locationID在 3 到 4 之间的库存产品，按其数量进行排名。结果需按LocationID进行分区，并在每个分区内按数量进行排序。返回字段包括：产品 ID、名称、库位 ID、数量及其排名。
